t: Open research earbuds packed with health and motion sensors.
steps: Buy the Developer Starter Bundle from the OpenWearables shop.
Install the OpenEarable app or the Python library to read sensor data.
Record a short session to the microSD card and read it on a computer.
Install VS Code and the nRF Connect SDK for firmware work.
Connect the included J-Link adapter to the debug header.
Build the firmware from the open-earable-2 repository and flash one earbud.
